normalization: Each probe records the observation value after removing dynamic identifiers and framework-specific transport details; the source and target normalized values MUST be deeply equal.

cases.atomic_claim: Importing the package root exposes OpenAiService, createAiService, AI_PROVIDERS, registerAiProvider, getAiProviders, getAiProvider, editorTools, editorFunctionTools, executeEditorFunctionTool, applyEditorToolProposal, defaultEditorToolRegistry, defaultEditorTools, EditorToolRegistry, EditorTool, EditorMutationTool, ApplyFormattingTool, ApplyTextEditsTool, GetEditorContextTool, InsertContentTool, ReplaceSelectionTool, and SearchDocumentTool; importing src/ai/index.ts exposes rebaseEditorToolProposal.
cases.surface: package root and src/ai/index.ts export map

cases.atomic_claim: TypeScript consumers can import every listed AI type by its existing name; assigning a current AiGenerateRequest, AiEditorContext, OpenAiServiceConfig, and AiEditorToolProposal to fixtures with the documented members compiles without removing or widening a member.

createAiService(existingService) returns the same object; createAiService({provider:'custom',generate:async()=> 'ok'}).generate(request,context) resolves {text:'ok'}; createAiService({provider:'openai',model:'gpt-4o-mini'}) returns an OpenAiService.

Constructing OpenAiService with provider, providers, model, apiKey, baseURL, client, organization, project, timeout, maxRetries, defaultHeaders, fetch, fetchOptions, dangerouslyAllowBrowser, response, and buildInput type-checks and constructs; removing any documented field from the config type fails.
new OpenAiService({provider:'openai',model:'gpt-4o-mini'}) satisfies AiService, exposes a readable client property, and its generate(request, context) returns Promise<AiGenerateResult>.
generate({prompt:'hello'}, context) resolves an object with text and optional raw and toolProposals; generate({prompt:'   '}, context) rejects with 'AI prompt cannot be empty'.

A request carrying prompt, instructions, scope, metadata, history, stream, onChunk, editorTools, and signal is accepted by generate; removing any one of those fields from the request type causes a consumer type error.

A context with a live Tiptap editor plus html, text, selectedText, selection {from,to}, and documentVersion is accepted; default input composition uses the snapshot values even when the live editor text changes after generate starts.
cases.surface: AiEditorContext live editor and snapshot fields

cases.atomic_claim: A proposal exposes id, tool, title, description, arguments, documentVersion, status, and optional message; status accepts only pending, applied, or discarded, and any other literal fails type-check.
applyEditorToolProposal returns an object with ok:boolean and message:string; a successful apply has ok true and a rejected apply has ok false with a message.
AiEditorToolApproval accepts 'always', 'never', an AiEditorToolName array, and a (proposal)=>boolean predicate; a value outside those alternatives fails type-check.
AiEditorToolName accepts exactly get_editor_context, search_document, replace_selection, insert_content, apply_formatting, and apply_text_edits; any other literal fails type-check.
A provider {id:'p',name:'P',model:'m'} and a provider with an added baseURL 'https://example.test/v1' both satisfy AiProviderDefinition; omitting id, name, or model fails type-check.

getAiProvider('openai') has no baseURL and model gpt-4o-mini; deepseek resolves to https://api.deepseek.com and deepseek-chat; qwen to https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 and qwen-plus; zhipu to https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 and glm-4-flash; moonshot to https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 and moonshot-v1-8k.

editorFunctionTools contains exactly six function tools named get_editor_context, search_document, replace_selection, insert_content, apply_formatting, and apply_text_edits with their existing descriptions and JSON schemas; changing a name or schema changes the observed definitions.

executeEditorFunctionTool('search_document', '{"query":"x"}', context) returns an EditorToolExecution with output and an optional proposal while retaining the name, rawArguments, context parameter order.

applyEditorToolProposal(editor, documentVersion, proposal) returns an AiEditorToolApplyResult and applies a valid pending proposal in one editor transaction; changing the argument order fails type-check.

package.json exports the import condition to dist/index.js with dist/index.d.ts and the require condition to dist/index.cjs with dist/index.d.cts; the built package has no UMD export and no browser-global AiEditor constructor.

generate({prompt:'go',stream:true}, context) with text deltas a, b, c calls onChunk in that order and resolves text 'abc'; providing only onChunk also streams, and the same ordering holds with editorTools:true.
generate({prompt:'go'}, context) resolves text equal to the final model output; with editorTools:true and model text rounds 'a' then 'b', it resolves text 'ab'.
cases.surface: non-streaming final-output and cross-round text accumulation

cases.atomic_claim: Start generate with context.text 'original' and selectedText 'ori', then mutate context.editor to 'mutated' while the request is pending; the default model input remains based on original and ori, while a tool may read the live editor.

Without buildInput, history [{role:'user',content:'u'},{role:'assistant',content:'a'}] and prompt 'p' render 'User: u\nAssistant: a\nUser: p'; scope defaults to selection when selectedText is non-empty and document otherwise; selection appends 'Selected text:' plus the selected plain text, document appends 'Document:' plus full plain text, none appends neither, and a supplied buildInput replaces the composition.
cases.surface: default input composition, scope, history, and buildInput override

cases.atomic_claim: generate({prompt:'p',instructions:'Be brief'}, context) sends 'Be brief' as model-level instructions while the user text contains only the prompt composition; concatenating the instructions into user text fails.

With editorTools:true and a model that calls a tool and then returns final text, generate exposes the six tool definitions, executes calls locally, continues until no calls remain, and returns accumulated text, accumulated toolProposals, and raw when a final response is available.
cases.surface: editor tool loop termination and accumulated result

cases.atomic_claim: When the model returns call id 'call_1', the next model round contains a function_call_output for exactly call_1 with that tool's JSON output; reusing call_1 for another call or reordering call identifiers fails.

With editorTools:true and a model that requests a tool call on every round, generate performs at most eight model rounds and rejects with 'AI exceeded the maximum editor tool call rounds'; issuing a ninth model request fails.

With stream:true, editorTools:true, and a streamed tool round that ends without a completed model response, generate rejects with 'AI response stream ended before completion' rather than returning partial text.

When a tool invocation throws Error('bad args'), the next model round receives JSON {ok:false,error:'bad args'}; a non-Error throw yields error 'Tool execution failed'; generation continues rather than aborting.
cases.surface: thrown tool-call output and loop continuation

cases.atomic_claim: executeEditorFunctionTool('replace_selection','{"text":"x"}', context with selection 1..3 and documentVersion 7) returns output {ok:true,status:'pending_user_approval',proposal_id:<id>} and a proposal with status pending and documentVersion 7.
cases.surface: proposal-producing tool output and initial proposal status

cases.atomic_claim: applyEditorToolProposal(editor, version, proposal for search_document or get_editor_context with status pending) returns a failure message '<tool name> is read-only and cannot be applied.' and leaves the document text unchanged.
new EditorToolRegistry([new ReplaceSelectionTool(), new ReplaceSelectionTool()]) throws 'Duplicate editor tool: replace_selection'; a registry with uniquely named tools constructs successfully.

executeEditorFunctionTool('missing','{}',context).output equals {ok:false,error:'Unknown editor tool: missing'}; applyEditorToolProposal(editor, version, proposal with tool missing and matching documentVersion) returns ok:false and leaves editor text unchanged.
cases.surface: unknown tool execution and apply behavior
